Editor's Note: This transcript was made from a copy from the Cassette Master. Due to differences in tape brand lengths (TDK-SAC90 to Ampex 90) the end of side 1 and the beginning and end of side 2 must be addended. Also, Cassette master of cassette I was virtually destroyed during the cassette copying process; it is characterized by a cyclical fade-out. Fortunately, a truncated copy of Cassette master I was made prior to this circumstance.
